name: PvP Essentials — Crosshair, Visible Ores, Sword & Low Fire
summary: All-in-one PvP pack: better crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin. One download, everything you need.
body:
**One pack, everything you need for PvP.** Combines our three most-downloaded packs into a single flagship, plus two quality-of-life tweaks.

### What's inside
- 🎯 **Better crosshair** — clean, high-visibility dot crosshair (our #1 pack, 24k+ downloads)
- ⛏️ **Visible ores** — every ore and ancient debris stands out, even through shaders (13k+ downloads)
- ⚔️ **Short sword** — smaller, cleaner swords for better PvP visibility (5k+ downloads)
- 🔥 **Low fire** — reduced fire overlay so it never blocks your view
- 🎃 **Clear pumpkin** — no more pumpkin blur when you wear one

### Why one pack?
Stop juggling 7 downloads. This is the consolidated flagship: better discoverability, one update to maintain, and all the social proof in one place.

---

**Also try the originals:** [Dot Crosshair](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dot-crosshair-cossx-better-crosshair) · [Visible Ores](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/visible-ores-all-versions-and-netherite) · [Short Sword](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-sword-little-sword-all-versions)
